approach_why: A product company with a technical hiring manager: questions a practitioner would ask show the fit faster than a list.

paragraphs.text: Three things I would want to understand first about your platform:

list.text: Which deploys still need a person to press a button, and why?
When a service fails at night, how long until the right engineer knows?
Do product teams own their services in production, or does one team own them all?

paragraphs.text: I have had to answer these myself. At Acme I cut release lead time from 10 days to under one day with trunk-based delivery and CI/CD. At Globex the incident rate came down 45% after SLOs, error budgets and a reworked on-call, and I moved 140 services from on-premises hosting to AWS and Kubernetes.
Happy to compare notes on a call.
